pages.text: Each hatch adds a companion to your collection ($(thing)10 slots$()): wolf, fox, allay, or iron golem for epic and legendary eggs.$(br2)Each one has random stats and $(thing)1 to 3 traits$(): ferocious, sturdy, swift, healer, tracker, guardian.

pages.name: Your companion
pages.text: Pick the active companion or release one at the $(l:progress/altar)Altar$().
Your companion follows you everywhere, even through portals. It heals when out of combat.$(br2)$(bad)Knocked out$()? It rests a few minutes before it can come back.
pages.title: In combat
